bullets.text: The Panthers took over first place in the NFC South at 3-5 even though they have lost three straight.
The Broncos are 7-2 on a five-game win streak, but their +12 point differential is far below the Jaguars' +108 at 6-2.
The Eagles have lost seven straight, and the Colts (five in a row) and Ravens (four) are also sliding.
